metrics.name: Answerable accuracy
metrics.definition: % of questions where the answer is grounded in retrieved chunks and factually correct against my CV.

metrics.name: Citation rate
metrics.definition: % of answers that include ≥1 inline citation to a retrieved chunk.

metrics.name: Refusal precision
metrics.definition: % of out-of-scope questions correctly refused (e.g., 'what's his shoe size').

metrics.name: Median latency
metrics.definition: p50 end-to-end time from user query to first streaming token.

metrics.name: p95 latency
metrics.definition: Slowest 5% of queries — the ones recruiters actually feel.

metrics.name: Cost per query
metrics.definition: Avg API cost per RAG query (embedding + retrieval + rerank + generation).
metrics.note: Migration to free tiers (Groq + Gemini + Cohere) eliminated per-query cost.

history.note: Added 12 new corpus chunks (project decisions, quotes, lessons). +4% on case-study questions.
Added Cohere reranking. Retrieval precision @5 jumped from 0.72 → 0.84.
Switched embedding model to gemini-embedding-001 (3072d). Better semantic recall on niche skills.
Original launch. Decent baseline but expensive.

failureExamples.question: What's his deepest experience in MLOps?
failureExamples.issue: MLOps wasn't tagged in corpus. Retriever returned only generic 'production AI' chunks.
failureExamples.fix: Added explicit MLOps chunk covering Azure ML, MLflow, eval harness, observability.

failureExamples.question: Has he worked with any specific Arabic NLP libraries?
failureExamples.issue: Model hallucinated Stanza when the actual answer was 'Azure Cognitive Services for Arabic'.
